jd.text:
Junior Data Scientist
📍 Remote (Saudi Arabia) | Full-Time

About the Role

We're looking for a Junior Data Scientist to join a growing analytics team focused on building data-driven solutions and improving business performance through modern technologies. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys working with data, automation, and emerging AI tools in a collaborative, fast-paced environment.

You'll work alongside analysts, engineers, and business stakeholders to support reporting, forecasting, automation, and advanced analytics initiatives across different business areas.

Key Responsibilities

- Analyze and interpret large datasets to support business decision-making
- Develop and maintain automated workflows using Python and SQL
- Create dashboards, reports, and visualizations using BI and analytics tools
- Support predictive analytics, segmentation, and forecasting projects
- Assist in building scalable reporting and data processing solutions
- Collaborate with technical and non-technical teams to translate business needs into data solutions
- Contribute to the maintenance and optimization of data models and pipelines

Requirements (Must-Have)

- Experience working with Python for data analysis, scripting, or automation
- Strong SQL knowledge and experience querying relational databases
- Familiarity with business intelligence or data visualization tools (e.g. Power BI, Tableau)
- Basic understanding of machine learning concepts (e.g. regression, classification)
- Foundational knowledge of statistics (hypothesis testing, distributions, correlation)
- Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving ability
- Clear communication skills — able to explain data insights to non-technical audiences

Nice-to-Have

- Understanding of cloud-based analytics or modern data platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure)
- Interest in AI-enabled workflows, automation, or applied data science
- Prior exposure to predictive modeling or forecasting projects

What We Offer

- Remote and flexible working environment
- Opportunity to work on modern analytics and AI-focused projects
- Supportive, collaborative team culture
- Professional development and learning opportunities
- Exposure to cloud technologies, automation, and scalable data solutions
- Career growth within an expanding team
- Performance-based incentives
- Wellness and work-life balance support

jd.text:
About the Role
We’re looking for a Senior Software Engineer – Full Stack to join our Engineering team at Moyasar and help us build and improve our digital payment products and services.
You’ll work across the stack using Ruby on Rails, PostgreSQL, Redis, and Sidekiq, building reliable solutions used by businesses and merchants to accept and manage payments. We’re looking for someone who thinks beyond the code someone who understands the business problem, helps shape the solution, and takes ownership from idea to delivery.

What You’ll Do
Build and improve full-stack features for Moyasar’s payment products and merchant services. 
Develop backend services, REST APIs, and user-facing web features. 
Build reliable integrations that support our payment ecosystem. 
Understand merchant and business needs and turn them into practical technical solutions. 
Take ownership of features from problem definition through development and production. 
Work with Ruby on Rails, PostgreSQL, Redis, and Sidekiq. 
Improve the performance, reliability, scalability, and security of our systems. 
Write clean, maintainable, and well-tested code. 
Contribute to architecture and technical decisions. 
Review code and support other engineers. 
Troubleshoot production issues and continuously improve our products.
Bachelor’s degree. 
5+ years of software engineering experience. 
Strong experience with Ruby and Ruby on Rails. 
Strong full-stack development experience. 
Experience with PostgreSQL, Redis, Sidekiq, and REST APIs. 
Experience building user-facing web products. 
Strong product mindset and ownership. 
Good understanding of testing, performance, and scalable system design. 
Strong problem-solving and communication skills. 
Experience in fintech, digital payments, or financial services is a strong plus.
